surface_mechanism_description: Adsorption of excess H2O and formation of hydroxides during oxygen precursor pulses were introduced as possible reasons for the result, while the partial decomposition of hydroxides and release of H2O during Pr(amd) pulses were suggested as reasons for the additional growth of the film material near the precursor inlet, which increases the thickness non-uniformity in the gas flow direction.
evidence: The partial decomposition of hydroxides and release of H2O during Pr(amd) pulses were suggested as reasons for the additional growth of the film material near the precursor inlet, which increases the thickness non-uniformity in the gas flow direction.
